changelog.title: Hex OS
changelog.description: One place to launch everything. A command line at /hex/ and an icon grid at /hex/apps.html, both reading the same index of every lab, course, hub, game and tool. Type run, or click. Nothing on the platform is reachable only by knowing where it lives.

changelog.title: It Answers in Your Own Spelling
changelog.description: Capitals do not matter any more: INFO ARENA, Man cd and LS CLOUD all work exactly like their lowercase versions. Tab completes commands, apps, houses and manual pages, and pressing it again cycles through the matches. When there is nothing to complete it tells you, instead of going quiet, because a silent key is indistinguishable from a broken one.

changelog.title: Your Labs, From Anywhere
changelog.description: ps, stop and restart now manage your own running lab sessions from the shell. A frozen box can be restarted from a clean state without hunting for the page you launched it from.

changelog.title: The Home Directory
changelog.description: A single page at /home.html showing what the server actually knows about you: proven awards, gates passed, quizzes and captured flags, each marked with where the fact came from. It reads and never writes, and it tells you when a record could not be loaded rather than quietly showing zero.

changelog.title: Install It
changelog.description: Hex OS installs to a Chromebook, tablet or laptop from the browser. Real icon, its own window, no browser chrome, nothing to flash and nothing from an app store.

changelog.title: Nothing Is Quietly Unreachable
changelog.description: A gate now fails the build if any listed thing points at a missing page, or at a page nothing links to. Cards that looked clickable and did nothing, and exams with no link from their own hub, are a class of problem that can no longer ship.
